frontend_assumptions: Limited native handoff uses its own expiring exact-ticket bearer and original MCP grant; it intentionally needs no dashboard session. It must not be described as a dashboard-cookie transfer.

Normal dashboard authenticated downloads still need captured frontend actor/authority cancellation through picker/body. Backend revalidation at headers or stream completion does not retroactively retract bytes already received.

Artifact/native stream completion is distinct from saved-copy delivery. Server enforces expected bytes/SHA and current authority before marking download complete; delivery endpoint independently requires full completion and matching saved-copy size/hash, then completes export history.

Client must preserve exact-byte checksum validation and avoid acknowledgement after cancellation, lost body, scope/lifetime changes or failed local save. Server cannot attest physical local disk persistence solely from a client-supplied acknowledgement.
server_evidence: mcp_native_transfers.credential accepts only one limited bearer, excludes query tokens and rejects unapproved browser Origin.
MCPNativeTransferService.limited rechecks original grant and constant-time secret; target matches owned artifact metadata and current allowed export preparation tool.
MCPArtifactService.stream bounds120s, checks expiry before each yielded chunk and verifies exact size/SHA, then fresh get/lock before marker.
native_transfer_runtime.download_content rechecks limited ticket at stream end and commits completion; any BaseException rolls back.
native_transfer_runtime.acknowledge_delivery rechecks limited ticket/marker/exact size/SHA and canonical artifact acknowledgement, no silent history advance from generation or metadata reads.
limits: Source review only, no new live transfer/service/provider tests during frontend freeze.
Fresh grant revocation is checked at completion rather than implying a revocation-push signal before every chunk; this trace does not claim instant recall of delivered bytes.
Focused supporting sources remain labeled focused with current hashes.
